changelog_records.title: CUAD retirement and captured Luna baseline
CUAD evidence recovery and claim correction (CG-25, partial)
Exact Unicode reference identity (CG-33; compatibility change)
Dynamic query analysis and budgets (CG-8 / CG-15)
Real comparison of the new completion models
First issue-registry fixes (CG-2, CG-4, CG-9, CG-17, CG-18)
The fetch-and-retry loop re-runs only the phase that missed (D11)
The planner moves RETURN-only `LET`s past SORT and LIMIT (D10, move-calculations-down)
A CGQL traversal can start from the enclosing row (D2)
CGQL gains array helpers, date arithmetic and casts/regex (D6/D7/D8)
CGQL gains a conditional expression, identifier helpers, and two AQL reflexes (D3/D4/D5)
Correlated subquery equality is now index-assisted (D1b) — the workload goes from 4 of 8 queries completing to 8 of 8
Endpoint-equality listing now uses the adjacency index (D1a)
CGQL v2 measured against an external 254k-document CRM workload
Relation-vocabulary normalization: attempted, measured, REJECTED (no code change)
Answer-quality head-to-head on REAL labels — the fixture result does not reproduce, and the reason is located
Sentence splitting no longer breaks on abbreviation periods
Per-fact semantics verdicts, persisted as a quarantined sidecar
Gate advisor gains a relation-semantics detector — a clean lane at 91.8%
Administrative relations are no longer drafted — precision 71.5% → 85.0%
Pilot-grade governed clinical graph from 100 real FDA labels, with measured precision
Per-document drafts stay ingestable: case-variant entities collapse
Per-document drafting runs as a durable background job
Corpus-boilerplate triggers are dropped at draft time
Semantic Neurons construction on real FDA labels — bottleneck found and fixed
M26 verified Semantic Repair materialization and deployment
M24 durable CAS custody and verified restoration
M19 signed governance and separation of duties
Error visibility: non-2xx request logging + a console logs panel
Admin CLI: application paths restored after the `/api` namespacing
Server-side text search backs the document browser
Query cache: request parameters partition the cache
Console: search-mode tabs on the Query screen
DailyMed operational pilot — governed construction on 10,000 real FDA drug labels, with the programme's first external ground-truth oracle
Multi-tenancy M2: per-tenant stores, routed at one structural choke point
2026-07-02 — Native-First: from prototype to self-contained product
